value.rationale: The recent spectral-class theory guarantees density for totally disconnected compact spaces and shows a 2D disk-fiber failure. A compact 1D Cantor bundle with an open ball of connected-spectrum functions shows the uniform dimensional guarantee is sharp. The proof isolates a nontrivial stable pairwise crossing mechanism and gives a quantitative neighborhood; the result is not merely a textbook reformulation of the published disk example.
